summary: Attempted to make linked web bundle rebuilds skip unchanged extensions by adding a 'stale' mode to the agent-server's rebuild logic. Multiple iterations of the edits to extension-reload.ts and related files left two tests failing (one about rebuild mode selection, one about error reporting), and the session ended before the work landed cleanly. Process diagnostics also confirmed an orphaned agent-server from earlier is still listening on :8787 holding an esbuild file lock.
errors: Two extension-reload.test.ts cases failed after edits: one expected 'rebuild all' but got 'rebuild stale', and one expected two diagnostics but got one ("Web bundle rebuild failed: vite exploded" missing).
Edits to extension-reload.ts did not stick in an earlier attempt, requiring the edits to be re-applied; one test still failed afterward.
An orphaned agent-server (PID 32992) running since 12:03 is still listening on :8787 and holds an esbuild service lock on the gizmo-registry node_modules, blocking clean rebuilds.
